question: What physical rejuvenation results from the described contemplative practice?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
These are presented as effects of the practice.
inference: The practice results in freedom from aging signs and all diseases.
uncertainties: The gender/case agreement between the two tokens is slightly ambiguous in isolation.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
